name: Mage’s Barracks
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bard 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a chip of stone, sand, a drop of water, and a wood splinter)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 20-ft.-by-80-ft. structure
Duration 2 hours/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as secure shelter, except it can house up to 40 medium-sized individuals. The building has doors at both ends and windows on either side of the doors. The doors and windows can be barred from the inside. The beds are basic bunk-beds, there are tables and stools enough for 20 at a time, two large fireplaces, and enough wood for one night. Additionally there is enough food for 40 medium individuals for one evening next to each fireplace.
